mapper.select: SELECT CONFIG_ID, CONFIG_NAME, CONFIG_CODE, DATA_SOURCE_TYPE, CONNECTION_URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD, DRIVER_CLASS, TABLE_NAME, SQL_QUERY, API_URL, API_METHOD, API_HEADERS, API_PARAMS, FILE_PATH, FILE_ENCODING, DELIMITER, QUOTE_CHAR, FIXED_WIDTH_CONFIG, DESCRIPTION, IS_ENABLED, IS_TESTED, TEST_TIME, TEST_RESULT, TENANT_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER FROM TBL_DATA_SOURCE_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_CODE = #{configCode} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}

SELECT CONFIG_ID, CONFIG_NAME, CONFIG_CODE, DATA_SOURCE_TYPE, CONNECTION_URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD, DRIVER_CLASS, TABLE_NAME, SQL_QUERY, API_URL, API_METHOD, API_HEADERS, API_PARAMS, FILE_PATH, FILE_ENCODING, DELIMITER, QUOTE_CHAR, FIXED_WIDTH_CONFIG, DESCRIPTION, IS_ENABLED, IS_TESTED, TEST_TIME, TEST_RESULT, TENANT_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER FROM TBL_DATA_SOURCE_CONFIG WHERE IS_ENABLED = 1 AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT CONFIG_ID, CONFIG_NAME, CONFIG_CODE, DATA_SOURCE_TYPE, CONNECTION_URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD, DRIVER_CLASS, TABLE_NAME, SQL_QUERY, API_URL, API_METHOD, API_HEADERS, API_PARAMS, FILE_PATH, FILE_ENCODING, DELIMITER, QUOTE_CHAR, FIXED_WIDTH_CONFIG, DESCRIPTION, IS_ENABLED, IS_TESTED, TEST_TIME, TEST_RESULT, TENANT_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER FROM TBL_DATA_SOURCE_CONFIG WHERE DATA_SOURCE_TYPE = #{dataSourceType} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_ENABLED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ENABLED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_TESTED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TESTED_COUNT FROM TBL_DATA_SOURCE_CONFIG WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}
